name: Codington County, SD
findings: Codington County has 100 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Codington County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
